overview: Based on the published agenda, the Administrative Policy Committee of the Village of Kronenwetter was scheduled to review monthly financial reports, discuss the 2027 operating budget preview, and consider a 10-year capital improvement plan update with funding and debt service analyses. The meeting was set to address fiscal planning and budget development for the upcoming year.

agenda.item: Approval of Minutes from August 18, 2026 Administrative Policy Committee Meeting
2027-2036 Capital Improvement Plan Budget - September 2026 Update

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review and take action on approval of the minutes from the previous Administrative Policy Committee meeting held on August 18, 2026.
The Finance Director was set to present a monthly update report to the committee. The specific contents were not detailed in the agenda.
The committee was scheduled to review the budget status report for August 2026 as part of ongoing fiscal monitoring.
The committee was expected to consider a preview of the village's proposed 2027 operating budget to begin the budget development process for the upcoming fiscal year.

discussions.item: 2027-2036 Capital Improvement Plan Budget - September 2026 Update
discussions.body: The committee was set to discuss an update to the 10-year capital improvement plan with components including funding analysis, debt service analysis, and Tax Incremental District projected closer analysis. This review was scheduled to inform long-term capital planning and financing decisions.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
